If a property entry field is unknown,
warn and discard the field.

-- test.glx --
persons:
  someone:
    properties:
      name:
        value: Someone
        fields:
          monkey: "undefined field"

-- want-errors --
persons\[someone\].Properties.name: field discarded: unknown field "monkey"

-- want-catalog.yaml --
persons:
    someone:
        properties:
            name:
                definition:
                    label: Name
                    value_type: string
                values:
                -   value: StringValue{"Someone"}
